project.name: TBC BigQuery JDBC Driver
project.description: Modern JDBC driver for Google BigQuery, built for Java 21+

arguments.argument: COUNT=$(grep -c 'beginline=' target/pmd.xml 2>/dev/null); echo "[PMD] ${COUNT:-0} violation(s)"; DUPES=$(grep -c '<duplication' target/cpd.xml 2>/dev/null); LINES=$(grep -o 'lines="[0-9]*"' target/cpd.xml 2>/dev/null | grep -o '[0-9]*' | paste -sd+ - | bc 2>/dev/null); echo "[CPD] ${DUPES:-0} duplication(s), ${LINES:-0} duplicated line(s)"
